rationale: The agent failed to request and confirm with the user the specific items to be returned from their order before processing a change. The user asked to return certain home office items but did not specify which items. The agent should have confirmed which items to cancel and not acted on the request without that confirmation. Additionally, if the cancellation of partial items is not permitted, the policy indicated that the agent should have kept the order and modified the user address as per the user's wishes, but this was not addressed properly in the conversation.
